answer: The defence here is semantic fingerprint via embedding hash: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the vault here is verification, the mesa of cost is what stops the farm, and the oasis of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
